samples.summary: `.claude/commands/self-review.md` does not exist anywhere in the repo, yet the todo file checks it off as delivered, and CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md all cite `/self-review` and its path as an existing, working slash command.
samples.evidence: Todo item: '- [x] `.claude/commands/self-review.md` — drives the bounded loop from any branch, no handoff, no `agent/` prefix, no cloud ownership.' A repo-wide search (`Glob '.claude/**'`, `Glob '**/self-review.md'`) finds no `.claude` directory at all in the working tree. The same missing path is asserted as authoritative in CLAUDE.md:65 ('3. **Self review** — `/self-review`: ...'), CONTRIBUTING.md:185 ('`/self-review` drives it; `/code-review`, ...'), and docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md:57 ('| Self review | `/self-review` — `.claude/commands/self-review.md` | ... |') and :79. Every reader following this PR's own instructions to run `/self-review` would find the command does not exist.

verdict.reason: Exhaustive search (Glob for .claude/**, **/self-review.md, **/.claude, **/commands/**, and Grep for "self-review" / "/self-review" across the whole tree including .trusted/) turns up no .claude/commands/self-review.md anywhere in the working tree, and no trace of it in git-tracked content search either. Yet docs/tasks/active/20260917-self-review-loop-todo.md:70 checks it off ('- [x] `.claude/commands/self-review.md` — drives the bounded loop...'), and CLAUDE.md:65, CONTRIBUTING.md:185, and docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md:57,79 all present `/self-review` and its backing file as an existing, working slash command. .gitignore:191 only excludes `.claude/settings.local.json`, not a whole `.claude/` directory, so there is no gitignore-based explanation for the file's absence — if it had been created it would be tracked. This is a real contradiction squarely in the Docs lens's rubric item 4 (documentation contradicted by this PR's own code/deliverables): the task file and three other docs assert a command exists and is invocable, but the artifact backing that command is not present anywhere in the repository a reader would check.
groundedIn: .gitignore:191 (only .claude/settings.local.json is ignored, not the whole .claude directory)
